description: Ministry of Economic Policy and Plan Implementation - Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008, Notice under Section 3(2)
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008, and primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters. It grants specific tax exemptions and regulatory benefits to a development project under statutory authority, making it a legal/regulatory instrument rather than a government personnel, organizational, or specialized administrative matter. The mention of Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa is incidental to the legal authority being exercised and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities that would make it a hybrid classification.
